subject: Request to pause trial countdown while finance routes PO
messages:
From: Jared Olsen <jared@bluesproutlabs.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pause trial countdown while PO routes

Hi Rishi,

Quick note from procurement land — our vendor onboarding team flagged one supplemental insurance item and IT is running a third-party review. Finance confirms a PO is being prepared but it won’t be signed until next week.

We’re mid-run with the pilot and seeing good signal, but the trial window is on a strict timer. Can Redwood pause the trial countdown (or issue short-term credits) while our PO routes? If possible we’d like to avoid losing sessions/results — the engineering team is deep in integration.

I attached the purchase worksheet I’m circulating internally (Procurement_Timeline.xlsx).

Appreciate any short-term help — Jared
Jared Olsen
VP, Product Engineering
BlueSprout Labs
Phone: (415) 555-0134

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Olsen <jared@bluesproutlabs.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pause trial countdown while PO routes

Hi Jared — thanks for the context and the timeline.

We can definitely help avoid losing momentum. Two quick asks so we can move this internally:
1) What exact PO ETA did finance give? (day/date)
2) Can you share the procurement contact so our billing team can follow up directly?

Options we can offer now (pending internal approvals):
- 7-day trial freeze (pause countdown) while PO finalizes
- or a temporary 5,000-token credit to keep the integration running and logs intact

I’ve looped Camila (AE) to coordinate approvals and get an expedited sign-off if needed. I’ve also attached a stub SOW and the quick-terms we typically use for short pauses (BlueSprout_SOW_v1.pdf). Let me know your preference and PO ETA and we’ll move it through.

Best —
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cell: (650) 555-2261

From: Jared Olsen <jared@bluesproutlabs.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@bluesproutlabs.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pause trial countdown while PO routes

Rishi — thanks for the quick reply.

Finance moved faster than expected on the budget approval but IT’s security review pushed the date. PO ETA: close of day Wed 2026-08-26. Procurement contact: Lina Chen (lina.chen@bluesproutlabs.com) — she’s tracking the signatures.

Given the timeline, a 10–14 day extension would be ideal so we can finish the last set of performance runs and a small end-to-end demo for leadership. If a formal freeze is easier operationally, that would also work.

I attached the procurement timeline we shared internally (Procurement_Timeline.xlsx). Happy to hop on a 15-minute call if you prefer.

Thanks — Jared

Subject: Re: Request: pause trial countdown while PO routes

Thanks for the details, Jared — and thanks Rishi for the handoff.

We want to keep BlueSprout’s evaluation intact. I’ve reviewed this with Billing and Product Ops. We can approve a 10-day trial extension starting 2026-08-25 and provision a temporary 5,000-token credit to ensure the integration doesn’t drop historic logs or cached prefixes.

Next steps for us:
- Rishi/CM to push the short SOW to DocuSign (attached link) for internal records.
- Jared: please introduce Lina Chen to kimberly_park@redwood.ai so Billing can confirm PO details and speed signature.

Cc’ing Kimberly for final approval on the top-up and to confirm the billing workflow. Kimberly — if you’re good with the 10-day start and the 5k token top-up, I’ll mark this as approved and notify Jared.

Appreciate the urgency — we’ll keep monitoring usage metrics on our end and loop back if anything changes.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
